_readme: Editable inputs for build_connector.py. All lengths in millimetres.
Frame: X/Y are HTC's tracker-model X/Y (socket axis at 0,0; stabilizing recess on +Y; pins on -Y).
Z is 'seat Z': 0 = the connector top face = the tracker's broad flat underside (HTC CAD z = -2.50). +Z points into the tracker.
Categories: sourced_htc_guide = numbers printed in HTC's guide; tracker CAD measurements live in tracker_interface.json (generated);
hardware_nominal = nominal values you supplied (NOT measured, NOT verified against a manufacturer drawing);
design = choices made for this connector; print_allowance = fit clearances and printing aids.
Calculated values are NOT stored here: the build derives them and writes output/derived_dimensions.json with formulas.
